channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump offers U.S. help to Russia after plague death; WHO assesses the situation as low risk
item.description: WHO said it was in contact with Russian authorities, and has offered support if needed, while assessing the risk to the general public as low based on available information.

item.title: Russian gold floods Hong Kong as Western sanctions redraw bullion trade
item.description: The surge underscores how Russia's gold trade has been rerouted after its invasion of Ukraine in 2022 shut its producers out of major Western markets.

item.title: Pentagon says Trump approves Army firing squad execution of Fort Hood killer Nidal Hasan
item.description: Former Army Maj. Nidal Hassan was sentenced to death after a court-martial that convicted him of killing 13 and wounding 32 others at an Army base in Texas.

item.title: Stock futures are little changed after Nasdaq hits new record: Live updates
item.description: The Nasdaq Composite jumped to a a fresh intraday all-time high and a record close on Monday.

item.title: Trump says MAGA Inc. PAC will pay for controversial TV ads that government funded
item.description: The New York Times reported "Trump personally instructed his budget director to use taxpayer money for TV ads praising him and his presidency."

item.title: AI researcher warns 'we are racing to build and grow our own adversary' in NYC hearing
item.description: The leading AI labs facing intensifying scrutiny over their safety and security practices.

item.title: Cocoa prices are climbing again. Here’s why this time is different
item.description: Cocoa prices are rising again as El Niño threatens West African supplies. Chocolate makers have few easy fixes to absorb higher costs.

item.title: 'We had a threat': Trump explains U.S. moving long-range bombers from UK
item.description: The U.S. Air Force B-1 bombers removed from England have been used in strikes on Iran.

item.title: House Democrat targets candidate prediction market trades after opponent’s Kalshi penalty
item.description: A new bill bans federal candidates from trading prediction market contracts related to their own elections and would result in a fine if violated.

item.title: Nokia CEO says data centers would be built '2x faster' without supply constraints
item.description: The Nokia CEO's comments underscores continued demand for AI even as top executives debate slowing down the pace of development.

item.title: Why airfares could rise even more, but airline profits won't
item.description: Airlines are trimming capacity as jet fuel prices keep climbing and travelers keep booking.

item.title: These are the cheapest and most expensive U.S. flights this November
item.description: Holiday airplane tickets are up more than 23% this year, according to Hopper.

item.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: Starbucks enters Xinjiang in calculated geopolitical risk
item.description: Starbucks struck one of Asia's most closely watched deals last year. Now it is getting headaches over choices made by a partner that leans toward Beijing.

item.title: These stocks could benefit from a midterm election shake-up, JPMorgan says
item.description: The midterms could reshuffle stock market winners. Here are JPMorgan's picks.

item.title: SpaceX stock climbs to highest since June, returning Musk to trillionaire status
item.description: SpaceX shares have bounced almost 60% off their low in early August, boosted by the company's AI business and Starship progress.

item.title: Lucid's Q3 deliveries fall 6.7% as EV maker cuts production to align with demand
item.description: Lucid delivered 3,806 EVs and produced 2,954 vehicles during the third quarter. That compared with 4,078 deliveries on production of 3,891 vehicles a year earlier.

item.title: GM says hybrid vehicles are coming: 'We're not tone deaf to our customers'
item.description: Hybrids are growing in popularity, as sales of the vehicles keep climbing.

item.title: Satya Nadella reinvented Microsoft once. Can he do it again in the AI era?
item.description: After succeeding Steve Ballmer in 2014, Satya Nadella turned Microsoft into a cloud giant. Now he's tasked with making the company a force in AI.

item.title: Stocks are hitting records despite surging yields. Cramer explains why
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said Nvidia, Microsoft and Meta are helping push stocks to records even as surging Treasury yields pressure much of the broader market.

item.title: Fairshake crypto PAC network backs 32 House candidates in midterms
item.description: The CLARITY Act failed in the Senate, raising the stakes for which lawmakers return to Congress to shape crypto regulation after the midterm elections.

item.title: Wall Street rewards Microsoft's AI pivot. A longtime skeptic says it's just the beginning
item.description: Melius Research's Ben Reitzes has warned about AI disrupting legacy software providers for years. Now, he loves Microsoft's place in the AI race.

item.title: Denied a credit card rate decrease? Here’s what to do next
item.description: Denied a lower credit card rate? You may still be able to cut interest costs through a hardship program, credit counseling or a balance transfer card.

item.title: Russia plague: What we know about the suspected case reportedly linked to a lab worker’s death
item.description: According to local media reports, as many as 189 people have also been placed under medical observation in Irkutsk in eastern Russia.

item.title: Brazilian stocks jump as Bolsonaro now seen as heavy favorite to win presidency
item.description: The moves come after the first round results of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday. Bolsonaro will face incumbent Lula da Silva in a runoff on Oct. 25.

item.title: China shuts hundreds of banks as Beijing moves to shore up its financial system
item.description: Beijing shuttered 670 mainly rural banks last year in a bid to create fewer, larger and better-capitalized lenders.

item.title: David Ellison just brought in a co-CEO to run his new empire: Meet Ynon Kreiz
item.description: Ynon Kreiz's appointment as co-CEO of Skydance answers a key governance question for Ellison's soon-to-be-merged company.

item.title: TNT Sports head Luis Silberwasser to depart Skydance as CBS Sports chief David Berson takes over combined global sports group
item.description: TNT Sports chief Luis Silberwasser will be leaving a combined Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery company, sources tell CNBC.

item.title: Starbucks recovery plan is working. Here's how Mike Khouw says to trade the coffee giant
item.description: Mike Khouw breaks down how he's trading Starbucks through options.

item.title: David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz announce Skydance leadership team
item.description: The leadership team for Skydance, the merged entity of Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery, will include Bari Weiss, Mark Thompson and Casey Bloys.

item.title: Cerebras stock pops 9% after Sam Altman calls the chipmaker a 'close partner'
item.description: Cerebras stock climbed in premarket trading after OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman reassured investors that the firm is a "close partner."
